newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Jospin, Britain's Blair to meet next week.
newsitem.headline: France's Jospin, Britain's Blair to meet next week.

text.p: British Prime Minister Tony Blair will meet his French counterpart Lionel Jospin next week during his holiday in southwest France, a Jospin aide said on Tuesday.
"They will meet informally, they are going to see one another," the aide said. He added that no date or place had yet been set for the meeting.
Blair is to arrive in southwest France on Sunday and stay a few days.
The British premier, his wife Cherie and their children Nicholas, Kathryn and Euan will be staying in the house of London lawyer David Keene in the village of Saint Martin d'Oydes.
The village is some 30 km (20 miles) from Cintegabelle, the main city in the parliamentary district represented by Jospin, France's Socialist prime minister.
